answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, published publicly on failure, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Each submission hangs on the canyon of a task receipt, and the meadow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Reaching the ember of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
